summary: The root نوي (nwy) primarily signifies intention, purpose, or resolve. It denotes the mental act of determining to do something, often with a clear aim or design in mind.

headwords.def: and He intended it, purposed it, designed it, aimed at it, proposed it to himself as the object of his aim.

اِنْتَوَى القَوْمُ مَنْزِلًا بِمَوْضِعِ كَ َا (S, Msb) The people, or party, repaired, or betook themselves, to, or towards, a place of alighting or abode, in such a place. (Msb.) See 1. اِنْتَوَى It (a people, or company of men,) removed from country to country, or town to town. (TA.)

Date-stones: they are often used as food for camels; (see إِبِلٌ نَوَوِيَّةٌ;) and for this purpose are bruised, and sometimes mixed with barley, and then moistened: see بَسِيسَةٌ. نَوَاةٌ What is cut off in the circumcision of a girl. (Lh, in TA, voce عُ ْرَةٌ.) The name shows that this is the prepuce of the clitoris, the end of which resembles the end of a date-stone. But see بَظْرٌ. النَّوَى What remains of the place of circumcision of a girl after that operation; i. e.

An intention, an intent, a purpose, a design, an aim; a determination of the mind, or heart: (Msb, TA:) this is the general meaning: (Msb:) the direction that one takes (S, Msb, K) in a journey, (S, K,) near or distant, (S,) and in an action: (K:) the thing that one intends, or purposes, or aims at: an affair: (Msb:) the place to which one purposes journeying: (S in art. زل:) see an ex. from a rájiz in art.
أَنَامُنْتَوٍ عَنْ هَ َا الأَمْرِ I. q. مَتَرَيِّعٌ, q. v. (TA in art. ريع.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
